articles.title: Oil Extends Gains as Hormuz Deal Remains Elusive: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: Global stocks traded near a record high as Asian investors renewed bets on artificial intelligence stocks after a month of volatility. Oil extended gains as Iran rejected talks with the US and a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz remained elusive.
